import React from 'react'; function Receipt({ data, onClose }) { const receiptNo = 'RCT-' + data.id + '-' + Date.now().toString().slice(-6); function handlePrint() { window.print(); } return (

Rental Successful!

Car has been assigned to customer

Receipt No.
{receiptNo}

Car Details

Car: {data.carName} Plate: {data.plateNumber} Rate: TSh {data.pricePerDay?.toLocaleString()}/day

Customer

Name: {data.customerName} Phone: {data.customerPhone}

Rental Period

Pickup: {data.pickupDate} Return: {data.returnDate} Duration: {data.rentalDays} day(s)
Total Amount Paid
TSh {data.totalCost?.toLocaleString()}
); } export default Receipt;
